reasoning: Gemini 3.2 is a specific minor version that requires both unreleased Gemini 3.1 and then 3.2 to ship by May 2026. While Google's release cadence has been fast, skipping to a new generation (e.g., Gemini 4) or delays are material risks. The implied 98.6% probability vastly overstates the certainty of this particular version number appearing on time.
evidence_points: Gemini 3.0 is not yet released as of April 2025; 3.1 and 3.2 must ship within ~14 months.
Google has occasionally jumped version numbers (e.g., from Gemini 1.0 to 1.5, bypassing intermediate versions).
The resolution criteria disqualify a jump to Gemini 4 or any non-3.2 labeled release, increasing the chance of a No outcome.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of Google Gemini release history and timelines
